ns2:section.sectionText: Students must enroll in lecture section (AL1) and lab section AB1 (36643) to complete registration in this course. Non-LIS graduate students and juniors and seniors must have permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu). Required travel at mid-semester and near end of semester. Syllabus will have course and travel details. An additional course fee of $70 (non-waived) and will be assessed to student's tuition and fees bill. See course website at http://courseweb.lis.illinois.edu/~mwolske/lis451/spring10/
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: GSLIS Field Trip Fee $70.00 Flat Fee.
